requirements.rule: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.
requirements.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

requirements.rule: Art. 43 (2024–2027 CCNL, PDF p. 40): the one-off three-month award for workers continuously employed since no later than 22 December 1997 is encoded; their 25-year milestone was reached by December 2022, before the agreement's 2025 run start. Art. 43(2) still awards two or three months on qualifying non-disciplinary termination before 25 years. Art. 43(3)–(4) preserves qualifying prior service across employer-initiated breaks of at most two months or specified interprovincial transfers. Repeated breaks can defer the milestone to 2026 or later; current employment inputs cannot reconstruct these histories or prove presence on the grandfathering date for a rehire.
requirements.remediation: Represent qualifying earlier employment periods, actual cumulative service, historical cohort membership for rehires, and qualifying non-disciplinary termination; then calculate the postponed milestone or early-departure award.

requirements.rule: D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 c. 5 keeps the operai agricoli out of the 9.50% minimum daily base, and the run applies no minimum to them. Tabella A of INPS circ. 6/2026 still lists 51.70 for the operai agricoli, 'non soggetto all'adeguamento' of art. 7 c. 1; no source found says whether it is a floor of their contribution base. A base below it may understate the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.contribution.minimum_base.services.minimum_base_paths; D.L. 463/1983 art. 7 cc. 1 and 5; INPS circ. 6/2026 allegato 1, Tabella A, note (2)
requirements.remediation: Source the role of the 51.70 of the operai agricoli (INPS circ. 43/2026 on the agricultural contributions, or the minimum daily wages of art. 1 L. 389/1989), then apply it as their minimum or record that none applies.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.
